user.title: Connect your Gedling bin calendar
user.description: On the Gedling bin collection website, search for your address, open the full/yearly collection-days calendar, then copy the final URL from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

data_description.calendar_url: The address-specific waste.digital.gedling.gov.uk URL containing webpage_token after you have selected your property and opened the yearly calendar.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Gedling bin collection website.
error.invalid_url: Enter the final address-specific Gedling yearly calendar URL, not the bin-collection search page.
error.invalid_or_expired: The saved Gedling calendar URL could not be opened. Generate a fresh yearly calendar URL on the council website.
error.no_calendar_data: The URL opened, but no yearly collection data was found. Make sure you copied the full/yearly collection-days page.

abort.already_configured: This Gedling bin calendar is already configured.
